title: Werner von Siemens on Electric Trolleys in Berlin-Lichterfelde
lineage: Inspected the cited passage; retained file is a paraphrased research note, not the original source. The Siemens letter is a translated excerpt, not the manuscript.

passages.locator: Letter to Wiedemann, 12 May 1881, translated excerpt
passages.note: Translated excerpt reports official testing and approval on 12 May 1881; Siemens reports loaded cars at 30–40 km/h, with inspectors restricting speed to 20 km/h. Original manuscript not inspected.
